protocol: Nine bench_b0 rows, grid4 n15/n30 and random500 n20 xD/A/I, seed0/restarts1/default1M; same-SHA unprofiled call then cProfile call, IDs/objective exact. Native C calls attributed by immediate Python caller. Direct function/kernel categories are disjoint. A/I N2 is _linear_pair_moves; D analogue is _two_candidates, with _linear_pair_moves explicitly0. Calls include generator resumptions. Residual=wall minus disjoint component cumulative times; includes all remaining native/Python setup, verification indexing/products, profiler/clock and wrapper overhead. No subtraction of overhead from measured wall.
verification_definition: A/I candidate verification component is only direct _linear_exchange cholesky_ex + cholesky_solve kernels as requested; trial matrix formation, trace/item and surrounding Python are in residual. Candidate cond is charged to condition. D verification uses _verified_information calls from k2_exchange, excluding start calls. Dual iterations are native cholesky_ex calls directly from _dual_floor (one per multiplicative iteration). Start includes randperm/sort plus immediate initial feasibility/information/criterion calls. Entries retain caller split so nested totals are not added twice.
iteration_definition: A/I one-swap iterations count _linear_scores calls, excluding a MAX_ITER terminal score-only state if present. D uses accepted swaps plus its terminal scan (unless MAX_ITER); original _one_candidates invocations are also retained as score_passes, including tie rescans. Accepted swap history is captured without modifying returned outputs.
